entries.name: E2B
entries.description: E2B — secure cloud sandboxes to run AI-generated code (Python/Node), with filesystem and process control. Offered via several x402 gateways.

usage.callShape: POST https://api.signalfuse.co/v1/gateway/execute/e2b with JSON body {code, language?, timeout?}
usage.outputShape: body.stdout[] (array of stdout lines), body.stderr[], body.results[], body.error (null on success)
usage.guide: Execute sandboxed code in an E2B cloud sandbox. POST to https://api.signalfuse.co/v1/gateway/execute/e2b with a JSON body containing required `code` (string). Optional: `language` (default "python") and `timeout` (integer seconds, capped at 60, default 30). Pay $0.005 USDC via x402 on Base. Read the result from `body.stdout` (an array of output lines), `body.stderr` for errors, and `body.error` which is null on success. Plain synchronous response, no polling or auth beyond x402.

entries.name: BlockRun Code Sandbox
entries.description: BlockRun Modal-backed code sandbox — create a sandbox, execute code, check status, and terminate.

usage.callShape: POST https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/modal/sandbox/create with JSON body {} (optional config fields like image, timeout, cpu, memory)
usage.outputShape: body.sandbox_id (the handle for follow-up calls), body.status (e.g. "running"), body.config.{image,timeout,cpu,memory,gpu}
quirks: Empty JSON body {} is accepted — backend applies defaults: image python:3.11, timeout 300s, cpu 1, memory 512MB, gpu null
Returns synchronously with status already 'running' (no polling needed for create)
sandbox_id (e.g. sb-...) is the session handle you must pass to companion endpoints (execute/status/terminate) — create is step 1 of a multi-step sandbox lifecycle
Charges $0.010 USDC on Base (eip155:8453) per create; the sandbox has a 300s default timeout so terminate or reuse promptly
usage.guide: POST to https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/modal/sandbox/create with an empty JSON body {} (x402 pays $0.01 USDC on Base automatically). The response is synchronous JSON: read body.sandbox_id and keep it — it is the handle you pass to the execute/status/terminate endpoints in the same sandbox service. body.status will already be "running" and body.config shows the applied defaults (python:3.11, 300s, 1 cpu, 512MB). To customize, send config fields in the body; otherwise defaults apply. The sandbox auto-expires after its timeout, so run your code and terminate (or let it expire) promptly.

entries.name: Code Execution Sandbox
entries.description: Run Python or Node.js code in an isolated, ephemeral sandbox and get back stdout/stderr/exit code. Pay-per-call x402, no account. Supports optional file uploads (base64) and configurable size/timeout tiers.

usage.callShape: POST JSON body {code (required), stack?: 'python'|'node' (default python), size?: 'small'|'med'|'large' (default small), timeout_seconds?: int, files?: {filename: base64string}}
usage.outputShape: stdout (string), stderr (string), exit_code (int), execution_time_ms (int), files (object filename->content), stack (string), size (string), sandbox_id (string)
quirks: DEFAULT backend = auteng ($0.002); railway gateway is same operation at $0.005.
auteng field is 'stack' (enum python|node), NOT 'language'. size enum is small|med|large (note 'med' not 'medium').
Only 'code' is required; stack/size default to python/small.
timeout_seconds beyond the tier default is billed per-second on top of base price (small base $0.002, med $0.008, large $0.03).
files are uploaded as filename -> base64 string map.

Railway gateway backend (x402-gateway-production.up.railway.app/api/code/run) advertises Python/JavaScript/Bash/R but does NOT publish its input schema in the 402 challenge; its exact field names (likely 'language' rather than 'stack') are UNVERIFIED. Origin endpoint scan only returned unrelated /solve/schedule and /solve/sensitivity solver routes — the /api/code/run URL itself is live and returns a code-sandbox 402.
Railway gateway accepts multiple networks/assets (Base USDC, eip155:4326 USDm, Solana USDC); auteng is Base USDC only.
usage.guide: Run Python or Node.js code in an isolated, ephemeral sandbox and get back stdout/stderr/exit code. Pay-per-call x402, no account. Supports optional file uploads (base64) and configurable size/timeout tiers. POST JSON body {code (required), stack?: 'python'|'node' (default python), size?: 'small'|'med'|'large' (default small), timeout_seconds?: int, files?: {filename: base64string}} Output: stdout (string), stderr (string), exit_code (int), execution_time_ms (int), files (object filename->content), stack (string), size (string), sandbox_id (string)

quirks: Host zero-daytona.zclk.cc returns NXDOMAIN — it does not resolve in DNS. Parent domain zclk.cc resolves via Cloudflare but this subdomain is dead.
qa-pay returned wallet-error/'provider request failed: fetch failed' (network-level, not a payment); nothing was paid.
Do not retry — the host is gone, not transient.
usage.guide: This endpoint is dead. The host zero-daytona.zclk.cc does not resolve (NXDOMAIN) — connections fail at the network layer before any payment. Do not attempt to call or pay it. The Daytona x402 sandbox service should be re-discovered at a current host or dropped from the registry.

entries.name: E2B Create Sandbox
entries.description: Create an E2B cloud sandbox (isolated VM for running agent code). Body { templateID }.

quirks: Served via Sponge's x402 gateway (*.x402.paysponge.com) — a single x402 payment proxies the upstream provider. No API key. Base or Solana USDC.
templateID is required (e.g. "base"). Returns a sandbox id used for subsequent (non-indexed) exec calls.
usage.guide: Create an E2B cloud sandbox (isolated VM for running agent code). Body { templateID }. Served via Sponge's x402 gateway (*.x402.paysponge.com) — a single x402 payment proxies the upstream provider. No API key. Base or Solana USDC.

entries.name: Execute In Modal Sandbox
entries.description: Execute a command inside an existing managed Modal sandbox.

usage.callShape: POST https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/modal/sandbox/exec with sandbox_id (from /sandbox/create) + command (array, e.g. ["python","-c","print(1)"]) → runs the command inside the existing Modal sandbox and returns stdout, stderr, and exit code synchronously.
quirks: command MUST be a JSON array (e.g. ["python","-c","print(1)"]); passing a string returns HTTP 400 'expected array' before any 402/charge
Requires a valid sandbox_id from /api/v1/modal/sandbox/create first - not a standalone call
OUTWARD/irreversible: arbitrary code execution inside a real sandbox; needs approval and should not be pay-tested casually
timeout is optional, in seconds, max 60 (default 60)
Sync response (no job id to poll) - returns result inline
Price is fixed $0.001; payment-required and x-payment-required headers (and www-authenticate) all carry the same base64 challenge
OUTWARD/irreversible — gated with needsApproval; not pay-tested in this batch.

entries.name: Check Modal Sandbox Status
entries.description: Check whether a sandbox is still running or has terminated.

usage.callShape: POST https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/modal/sandbox/status with body {sandbox_id} -> returns whether the Modal sandbox is running or terminated (sync JSON result).
quirks: sandbox_id must be a real ID returned by /api/v1/modal/sandbox/create; a fake/expired ID may charge then return an error or empty status (charge-then-error risk)
Fixed price $0.001 (1000 atomic USDC units, 6 decimals) on Base eip155:8453
x402 v2 challenge served in both www-authenticate and payment-required / x-payment-required base64 headers, plus JSON body paymentInfo
Read-only and idempotent: checking status does NOT create/terminate the sandbox (outward=false), unlike sandbox create/exec/terminate

entries.name: Terminate Modal Sandbox
entries.description: Terminate a running sandbox and release its resources.

usage.callShape: POST https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/modal/sandbox/terminate with body {sandbox_id} -> terminates the running Modal sandbox and releases its resources; returns a sync {result} object.
quirks: OUTWARD/irreversible: destroys a live sandbox and its state — do NOT pay-test casually, needs approval
sandbox_id must come from a prior POST /api/v1/modal/sandbox/create — a fake/expired id likely returns an error AFTER charging (charge-then-error risk)
Pay-testing requires first creating (and paying for) a sandbox, so the true cost to exercise this is create-cost + this $0.001
x402 v2 challenge: USDC on Base (eip155:8453), amount 1000 atomic = $0.001; accepts in payment-required / x-payment-required / www-authenticate headers and JSON body
Sync response (no job id to poll)
OUTWARD/irreversible — gated with needsApproval; not pay-tested in this batch.
